None is a blocker. The three below are recorded in `checks/M0-s-01-notes.md`:
- **N-24 (session note):** under a flow label, a giver whose file passed to a receiver that has not landed loses its
  claim on its next re-landing. This affects five items' file lists, among them M0-f-03a's `workLimits.json` (receiver
